subject: Renewal discussion: stability credit + burst cap amendment
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@heliocommerce.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@heliocommerce.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal proposal — stability credit + burst cap amendment

Hi Amy / Tom,

Thanks for the call earlier — appreciate the transparency on seasonality and the spike risk around Q4. Attached is a concise renewal proposal that aims to balance predictable unit economics for you while giving Helio headroom for bursts:

- 12-month renewal starting 2026-07-01
- 10% list discount on hosted inference rates (applies to sustained usage)
- One-time stability credit of $45,000 applied across the first 60 days post-renewal to soften any on-boarding re-run costs
- Burst cap: guaranteed burst capacity up to 2.5x baseline for sustained 72-hr windows; overage billed at a capped premium rate (details in attachment)
- Optional add-on: dedicated burst pool reservation (separate SKU) if you want guaranteed reserved GPUs

Two asks from our side:
1) Acceptance of the 60-day stability credit window (we apply credit upon invoice generation)
2) Commitment to notify us 10 business days prior to any planned traffic migration so we can scale routing and caching policies

I copied Tom so procurement has the same view. If these terms look reasonable, I can send a DocuSign-ready version and loop in Marissa/Ben to fast-track approvals on our side.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 2026-05-07_Renewal_Proposal_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Amy Chen <amy@heliocommerce.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliocommerce.com
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 14:11:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — stability credit + burst cap amendment

Rishi — thanks for this. Overall this is trending in the right direction. A couple items from our side before we sign: 

- Can we narrow the stability credit window to 45 days instead of 60? Finance prefers faster recognition of concessions.
- For the burst cap: Helio needs a per-month aggregate burst allowance (not just 72-hr windows). Is it possible to split the burst into a monthly buffer (e.g., 1.5x baseline for up to 10% of days per month) plus emergency 72-hr allowance?
- Procurement also asked whether the stability credit can be shown as a line-item on the first invoice (they want visibility for audit).

I'll also note Tom asked if we can get a one-off onboarding credit applied earlier (we can propose shifting a portion of the $45k to an onboarding credit). Can you share a revised attachment that shows the credit split and a sample invoice line?

Thanks — Amy
VP Product Operations, Helio Commerce
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@heliocommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@heliocommerce.com>, procurement@heliocommerce.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — stability credit + burst cap amendment

Amy / Tom — thanks, and good suggestions. Looping in Marissa (sales ops) and Ben (rev ops) to confirm on accounting and billing. Proposed adjustments inline below and attached a redline: redlines_helio_may2026.docx

- Stability credit: split $45,000 into $30,000 onboarding credit (applied on month-1 invoice as line-item) + $15,000 stability credit applied across months 2–3 (shown on invoices as a separate credit line). This addresses audit visibility and accelerates recognition for Helio.
- Burst policy: offer a two-tiered burst: monthly buffer = 1.5x baseline for up to 10% of days in a month; emergency 72-hr spike up to 2.5x baseline (as previously described). Overage beyond both tiers billed at capped premium (5% above list rate), with a monthly report we will provide.
- Billing visibility: we will include credit line items and provide a sample invoice PDF before signature.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm we can: (1) show the onboarding credit on the first invoice as a distinct line, (2) accept the 45-day accelerated recognition path (they asked 45 vs our original 60), and (3) approve the burst cap wording for the SOW? If yes, I can send a DocuSign with the updated redline and a short cover email.

Action items for this thread:
- Rishi: prepare DocuSign (updated) and sample invoice (by 5/14)
- Marissa / Ben: internal sign-off on credit presentation and SOW wording (by 5/14)

Thanks — Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@heliocommerce.com>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@heliocommerce.com>, procurement@heliocommerce.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:09:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — stability credit + burst cap amendment

Rishi / Ben — internal review complete. We can implement the credit split as requested and show the onboarding credit as a separate line on the first invoice. The 45-day accelerated recognition is acceptable to finance given the onboarding credit upfront. Ben confirmed the burst cap wording is operationally feasible; we'll include monthly telemetry reports for Helio.

Next steps:
- Rishi: send the DocuSign packet (updated SOW + sample invoice PDF) and copy legal for the small redline on the burst clause.
- Amy / Tom / procurement: if you approve the redline, I will instruct legal to finalize and route for signature.

I attached a checklist to make the sign-off process smoother.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: signing_checklist_may2026.pdf (PDF)
